title: An Old Water-Carrier Woman Identifies Sis Ganj

blocks.text: Attention then turns to the most delicate of the Delhi sites. The seventh Sikh shrine Sis Ganj has become difficult to identify precisely because later construction obscured the original place of martyrdom.

Resolution comes through living memory rather than royal paperwork alone. An old water-carrier woman identifies the place, Ram Dyal mediates the tension that follows, and even the surviving structure is negotiated down to one-fourth of Mosgue wall so the sacred location can be marked without igniting needless chaos.

Once the spot is accepted, the seventh Khalsa flag is raised and the shrine is established. The page shows historical recovery happening through witness, compromise, and determined insistence on memory.
